item.title: NSe — Future Boundary Conditions
item.description:
Cross-model, cross-scenario summary of NSe’s future open-boundary conditions: delta-change temperature/salinity (CMIP6, bias-corrected against the CMEMS Northwest Shelf reanalysis), tidal elevation/currents (TPXO9 plus the CMIP6 ensemble-mean sea-level trend), and (as of 2026-09-22) delta-change biogeochemistry – nitrate, phosphate, silicate, oxygen, dissolved inorganic carbon, and alkalinity – across all three CMIP6 models and both scenarios (see the bug-fix campaign section below for how that came together).

Delta-change (temperature / salinity)

Temperature (thetao)

Source: AMM7/AMM15 delta-change: GFDL-ESM4/ssp126 [1985-01-01–2014-12-31 vs 2015-01-01–2100-12-31]
